title: Slack Thread to Linear Issue via MCP
summary: Turn a Slack thread into a well-formed Linear issue using the Slack and Linear MCP servers.
setup: In Studio, open MCP Servers and connect Slack and Linear from the registry. Keep the server ids `slack` and `linear`.
Run the playbook with a channel id, the thread's parent timestamp, and your Linear team.
If a tool name or argument differs in your MCP server version, adjust the call in steps/*.ts (use Studio's tool list for the exact names).
